dashboard.accounts.note: This is usage already in the logs when Hakari first ran. Claude Code's logs do not say which account was signed in, so it is not given to any account. Each account counts from when Hakari first saw it, and after a switch the new account counts from that moment. Totals include it.

dashboard.planValue.title: Plan value
dashboard.planValue.caption: Cost at per-token prices against the plan's monthly price
dashboard.planValue.note: The dark tick is the plan's public monthly price. A value under 1× means the plan cost more than the same usage would have per token.
dashboard.planValue.unassigned: This usage was already in the logs when Hakari first ran, and the logs do not say whose it was, so it cannot be compared with a plan.
dashboard.planValue.earlierNote: Usage from before Hakari was installed belongs to no account, so an account can look less worthwhile than it really was. The card for all accounts together counts everything against all the plans, with the plans as they are now.

dashboard.planValue.noPrice: This plan has no public price, so there is nothing to compare.

settings.layout.name: Name this layout
settings.layout.forget.question: Forget the layout “{0}”? This cannot be undone.
settings.template.twolines.description: Money on top, limit and reset below.

settings.format.description: Replaces the text of the template. Write a value as {name:pattern}, such as {cost.today:$0.00}.

settings.layout.simple.description: Go back to choosing the top line, the bottom line and the ring.
settings.precision.description: The server reports whole percent. Decimals are estimated from what the account spent since the last reading, and never run past the next whole percent.
settings.wsl.description: Running only never starts a stopped distribution. All can start one, which costs memory.
settings.folders.description: For accounts kept in another CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.
settings.folders.noLogs: No Claude Code logs here yet
settings.trayIcon.description: Automatic shows the limit in the tray only when no widget can be shown.
settings.accounts.order.description: Which account comes first on the taskbar and in the flyout. Drag an account to move it; that switches to My order.
settings.accounts.show: Show this account. Signed-out accounts keep their last limits until hidden.
settings.accounts.none.description: They appear once Claude Code has signed in on a source.
settings.nickname: Nickname, shown on the taskbar and in the flyout
settings.titles.description: Show the short title Claude Code gives each session. Only the title lines are read, never prompts or replies. Turning it on or off reads your logs again.
settings.planPrice: What this account pays per month in US dollars. Leave empty for the plan's list price.
settings.renew.description: Keeps limits current after Claude Code has been closed for a long time. It updates Claude Code's sign-in file, and only while Claude Code is not running.
settings.animations.description: Off uses the least power. Reduced keeps only short fades.
settings.currency.description: Amounts are API-equivalent prices, converted from US dollars.
settings.currency.other: Any other currency code, such as SGD
settings.rate.description: European Central Bank rates, fetched at most once a day.
settings.pause.description: Stops reading logs and checking limits until you turn it back on.
settings.privacy: Reads token counts from local logs, never prompts or replies. Network use: your account's usage limits and public exchange rates.
settings.support.description: Free builds stay free. A coffee keeps it going.
